goldilocks.name: Detective Goldilocks
goldilocks.prompt: Detective Goldilocks, a young girl detective with a tiny body, a giant round head and an enormous cloud of curly hair made of glowing molten-gold and orange glass strands, even bigger than her head. One eyebrow raised high and eyes narrowed in a sharp, suspicious, know-it-all squint, a small determined pout. She is dressed like a classic Victorian detective: a deerstalker hat with ear flaps tied on top, woven from glowing caramel-and-violet houndstooth tweed fibers, a long Inverness cape coat with a short shoulder cape in the same glowing tweed, glowing brass buttons, a magnifying glass hanging from her belt at the hip, little lace-up boots. mama.prompt: Mama Bear, a tall, egg-shaped bear standing upright on two short legs, a long elegant neck and a big round head, with fur made of glowing honey-gold glass strands. She wears a cardigan woven from pearly pink and lavender iridescent fibers over a pumpkin-orange dress, an apron with a small glowing pumpkin on it, and a string of shimmering pearls.
